harper: Quick postmortem follow-up for the streaming outage. Pattern: handshake timeouts -> truncated streams -> reconnect storms. Need owners for small, testable tasks and a strict canary plan. Short replies please.

noah: I'll own server telemetry and hypothesis. Plan: emit stream.accept.queue.p95/p99, per-worker socket counts, and capture 200 sample handshake failures. ETA Mon.

harper: I'll own dashboards & runbook. Runbook should include quick rollback steps and queries.

noah: For fix: put extended handshake (3s->6s) behind flag + add a soft accept cap to shed bursty connects. Will open tiny RFC.

harper: SDKs need backoff + max-conns. Who owns SDKs?

noah: @harper can coordinate SDK owners; propose exponential backoff with capped jitter and only auto-retry if idempotent.

devops-bot: Canary job created -> 3560010000, target shards: staging-1..3 :rocket:

harper: Canary window proposal 01:00-05:00 UTC Thu. Rollback triggers: partial_rate > 2x baseline OR total 5xx increase > 0.4%. Agree?

noah: Agree. I'll add alerts and dashboard panels, and post links.

harper: I'll draft a two-page runbook and start weekly check-ins until closed. Next sync Fri 09:00 PT.

noah: ack.

harper: ack.

devops-bot: INF ticket INF-6210 created for harness quota.

harper: Thanks team, ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
